requirements.requirement: Three bases joined at a corner
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full and piece:0,1,1;full mutually adjacent at level 1, meeting at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0

requirements.requirement: Standing on a stud spike that faces down under that corner
requirements.evidence: No spike placed; base level at 1 has no piece below to host a down-facing stud spike (SPIKE_CLASH when pieces occupy both levels). Offer s47 exists for a spike at level 1 junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 but requires the default variant; stud-down variant was not placed and current build has no spike ref.

finish.summary: Three bases are placed joined at a corner at level 1, but the stud spike facing down under that corner is not placed. Attempt to add stud-down spike was refused with SPIKE_CLASH when a supporting piece existed, and was not completed after rebuild.
